results.name: Cache evicts the least recently read entry and bounds total weight
Cache age is measured from loading, not kept forever by repeated reads
Replacing an entry releases its prior weight; oversized rows are not retained
Expired entries are swept on write; clear releases cached payloads
Two concurrent resource reads share one loader
Failed resource reads can retry instead of caching an empty failure
Partial resource results may be shown without caching the failure
Invalidation prevents an older in-flight request from replacing refreshed data
Clear cannot be undone by a delayed successful read
Many film versions scan their paths linearly and keep every copy
Finished lookup is reused within a catalog pass, then refreshed on the next pass
Recent copy ordering, resume and duplicate counts remain consistent
